name: tradekit
description: The hyperliquid framework as a standard (tradekit/1) for copy-trading venue modules: one fn surface, config shape and layout shared by hyperliquid, polymarket and dydx. check/board report conformance statically; scaffold copies the framework (Python orchestrator + Rust axum API + MCP + canonical Strat base) into a new venue module. Pure python, no server, no keys.

layout.src/standard.py: the tradekit/1 spec + static conformance checker
layout.src/template/: the framework copied from hyperliquid, with __NAME__/__VENUE__/__API_PORT__ placeholders
